problem_text:
In this scheduling problem, a single project consists of named activities. Each named activity has one fixed duration and one fixed renewable-resource requirement profile that applies throughout its execution.

Your task is to assign a start time to every named activity so that all precedence and renewable-resource constraints are satisfied and the makespan is minimized.

Rules:
- Every named activity must be scheduled exactly once.
- Activities are non-preemptive: once an activity starts, it runs to completion without interruption.
- A successor activity cannot start until all of its listed predecessors have finished.
- For every renewable resource and every time period, the total demand from all active activities must not exceed that resource's capacity.
- The named start milestone must have start time 0.
- The named finish milestone must have start time equal to the makespan.


Where:
- Each integer is the start time of that named activity.
- Start times are non-negative integers.

Here, the construction delivery program setting contains a single construction project with 30 real tasks and 32 total activities once the two milestones are included. The project uses the following renewable resources: Survey Crew, Concrete Crew, Steel and Framing Crew, and Mechanical and Electrical Crew. Below, each activity definition states its duration and per-period demand on every renewable resource, and the remaining constraints give the required precedences. The activity statements include only nonzero renewable-resource demands, so any renewable resource not listed for a given activity is used at level 0.

For the start milestone Site Notice to Proceed, the duration is 0 time units and the active demand is no renewable resources.
Site Survey requires 4 crew members from Concrete Crew and 8 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew during execution and has duration 10 time units.
Systems Rough-In has to finish before Closeout Packaging begins.
Site Survey must be completed before Systems Rough-In starts.
For Envelope Installation, the duration is 3 time units, and the required resources while active are 3 crew members from Survey Crew and 1 crew member from Steel and Framing Crew.
Systems Rough-In takes 3 time units to complete and requires 1 crew member from Survey Crew, 9 crew members from Concrete Crew, 7 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 3 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Starting Weather Protection Setup is contingent on the completion of Material Receiving.
Ground Preparation requires 7 crew members from Survey Crew, 4 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 6 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew during execution and has duration 9 time units.
The instance assigns Punch Walk Prep a duration of 1 time unit together with resource demand 9 crew members from Survey Crew, 10 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 3 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Warranty Package Review is defined by duration 3 time units together with a demand of 6 crew members from Survey Crew, 9 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 9 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Owner Orientation remains active for 7 time units and draws 6 crew members from Survey Crew, 2 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 5 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew over that span.
Mobilization Planning may start only after Commissioning Prep is complete.
coordination must be completed before any activity in Ground Preparation, Envelope Installation, and Safety Walkthrough starts.
While Interior Fit-Out is active, it requires 2 crew members from Survey Crew, 5 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 7 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew; its duration is 10 time units.
Site Notice to Proceed has to be complete before any of Material Receiving, Waste Removal Planning, and Traffic Control Setup is permitted to start.
Inspection Coordination has to be complete before Commissioning Prep is permitted to start.
Foundation Layout must be completed before Material Staging starts.
Each of Foundation Layout and Structural Framing may start only after Warranty Package Review is complete.
Utility Marking must be completed before Final Handover starts.
Completion of Client Inspection is required before Closeout Packaging can begin.
Closeout Packaging must finish before final handover can start.
Completion of Permit Review is required before Envelope Installation can begin.
The start of every activity in Structural Framing, Systems Rough-In, and Mobilization Planning requires prior completion of Temporary Power Review.
Before Final Handover can start, Mobilization Planning must have finished.
Steel and Framing Crew makes 22 crew members available in each period.
Starting Punch List Review is contingent on the completion of Interior Fit-Out.
Material Staging has duration 9 and requires 0 crew members of Survey Crew, 0 crew members of Concrete Crew, 2 crew members of Steel and Framing Crew, 7 crew members of Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Prior completion of Punch Walk Prep is necessary before any of Site Survey and Ground Preparation starts.
While Weather Protection Setup is active, it requires 6 crew members from Survey Crew, 1 crew member from Concrete Crew, and 8 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew; its duration is 3 time units.
Closeout Audit has a processing time of 10 time units and uses 6 crew members from Survey Crew, 6 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 9 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew whenever it is active.
Waste Removal Planning is defined by duration 5 time units together with a demand of 1 crew member from Survey Crew, 4 crew members from Concrete Crew, 8 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 9 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Completion of Owner Orientation is required before Warranty Package Review, Final Cleaning Review, and Inspection Coordination can start.
During its execution, Mobilization Planning uses 1 crew member from Survey Crew, 7 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 6 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew and has duration 7 time units.
Closeout Packaging executes for 2 time units and needs 3 crew members from Concrete Crew and 8 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew for the entire time it is active.
Inspection Coordination is associated with duration 7 time units and with demand 8 crew members from Survey Crew, 6 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 1 crew member from Mechanical and Electrical Crew whenever it is active.
Final Handover is the designated finish milestone; its duration is 0 time units, and it uses no renewable resources while it is active.
coordination remains active for 2 time units and draws 3 crew members from Survey Crew, 5 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 6 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew over that span.
The instance assigns As-Built Compilation a duration of 2 time units together with resource demand 5 crew members from Survey Crew, 7 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 5 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew while active.
Mobilization Planning cannot start until Punch List Review has finished.
Permit Review spans 8 time units and requires 4 crew members from Concrete Crew, 7 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 9 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew over its active period.
Temporary Power Review takes 4 time units to complete and requires 2 crew members from Survey Crew, 3 crew members from Concrete Crew, 5 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 1 crew member from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while active.
Prior completion of Turnover Meeting is necessary before any of Closeout Audit and Utility Marking starts.
Survey Crew is limited to 27 crew members during every time period.
Turnover Meeting remains active for 3 time units and draws 7 crew members from Survey Crew, 7 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 3 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew over that span.
Safety Walkthrough is associated with duration 9 time units and with demand 4 crew members from Survey Crew, 8 crew members from Concrete Crew, 7 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 9 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew whenever it is active.
Starting Systems Rough-In is contingent on the completion of Ground Preparation.
Commissioning Prep is associated with duration 7 time units and with demand 10 crew members from Survey Crew and 5 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew whenever it is active.
The active profile of Structural Framing is duration 6 time units with resource usage 6 crew members from Survey Crew, 10 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 8 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew.
Concrete Crew is limited to 17 crew members during every time period.
Completion of Waste Removal Planning is required before Punch Walk Prep and Turnover Meeting can start.
The per-period capacity of Mechanical and Electrical Crew is 21 crew members.
Client Inspection is allowed to start only once Safety Walkthrough has finished.
Completion of Closeout Audit is required before Interior Fit-Out can begin.
No activity in Owner Orientation and coordination can begin prior to the completion of Traffic Control Setup.
Utility Marking has an active duration of 5 time units and calls for 9 crew members from Survey Crew, 1 crew member from Concrete Crew, 4 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 2 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew.
The start of every activity in Permit Review, Interior Fit-Out, and Material Staging requires prior completion of Final Cleaning Review.
Structural Framing must finish before utility marking can start.
While Material Receiving is active, it requires 8 crew members from Survey Crew, 9 crew members from Concrete Crew, 10 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 2 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew; its duration is 2 time units.
Client Inspection may not begin until after Material Staging has been completed.
Client Inspection is associated with duration 8 time units and with demand 5 crew members from Survey Crew, 10 crew members from Concrete Crew, 9 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 1 crew member from Mechanical and Electrical Crew whenever it is active.
As-Built Compilation has to be complete before Commissioning Prep is permitted to start.
Before Temporary Power Review and As-Built Compilation can start, Weather Protection Setup must have been completed.
Traffic Control Setup runs for 8 time units and consumes 1 crew member from Concrete Crew, 6 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 3 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew while it is active.
Punch List Review has duration 10 time units; while it runs, it uses 9 crew members from Survey Crew, 6 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew, and 4 crew members from Mechanical and Electrical Crew.
Starting any activity in Punch List Review and Client Inspection is contingent on the completion of Envelope Installation.
The duration of Foundation Layout is 6 time units, and while active it requires 8 crew members from Survey Crew and 8 crew members from Concrete Crew.
The duration of Final Cleaning Review is 7 time units, and while active it requires 10 crew members from Survey Crew, 2 crew members from Concrete Crew, and 3 crew members from Steel and Framing Crew.
prompt_text:
Response Format:
<ActivityName>: <integer>
<ActivityName>: <integer>
...

Example: "Project Kickoff: 0"

Rules:
- Use the exact activity names from the instance description.
- Include every activity exactly once, including the named start milestone and named finish milestone.
- List the activities in the same order they are introduced in the activity-definition constraints.
- The integer after the colon is the start time of the activity. Do not prefix it with "start="; do not include "mode=" (that is the multi-mode variant's format).
- Do not emit a "Total makespan:" line or any other summary line.
- Output schedule lines only; do not add a makespan line or any other text.
